displayPattern: Display on an LG dishwasher after power was cut: PF
meaning: Power restored: LG says PF is not an error. Power was cut, and the dishwasher will remember the point it had reached and continue from there.
causes: A power outage during a cycle
The dishwasher was unplugged during a cycle
diySteps: PF is not a fault. LG says the dishwasher recalls the last operation from before the power cut
Press the start/pause button to start it again
This is not the LG washer PF reset. The washer instructions are a different appliance
safetyNote: Switch the dishwasher off at its breaker before you reach into the base or remove a filter or cover, and let the tub and water cool after a cycle. Watch for sharp debris. Pump, heater, valve and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: Do not request service only because PF appeared after an outage or after the dishwasher was unplugged. Press start/pause. If a different code is on the display after power is back, follow that code. LG notes that codes can differ by model.
sourceTitle: [LG Dishwasher] Guide to Error Codes (LG USA Support)
